verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the story almost word for word: users can assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request, then refine, iterate, approve and merge it in GitHub Mobile. Agent Tasks also let users start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks from the app. The evidence is marketing-level only, and the community items are about unrelated app features. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assign-to-Copilot flow, and in-depth documentation of agent task behavior and limits on mobile.
